items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: That's Robert and Clarence and Edmund.

ctx.x: Well, there's one come here in the city, was playing, I was playing saxophone. And I couldn't remember his name. I know he was playing alto saxophone, the one he sung.
That's Robert and Clarence and Edmund.
Edmund, I believe that's the one who was playing saxophone.
